scope: Fixed entire intersection of18already-local pages, three historical OCR caches and source image; development stress batch preselected for old citation studies, not a random corpus or independent confirmation
source_selection: All18eligible intersections; no selecting pages by shared omission outcome
independence_limits: Different OCR model families; input page identifiers agree, but exact original resize/prompt/finish reasons are unavailable. Do not claim matched cached costs or proven normal termination.
denominators: 18pages, all nonignored English text-block tokens and all numeric footnote_mark spans on those blocks; report eligible blocks/tokens/spans and reviewed common deletion spans separately
screening: Normalize markup, tokenize text, align each cached output to source-order gold by SequenceMatcher; intersection of delete opcodes is only a candidate. All candidates require image+raw-output manual audit. Replacements are not automatically omissions.
types: long run>=8word tokens; short numeric/superscript span separately; remaining lexical runs separately. Physical whole-line/region status requires image inspection.
normal_output: Visible normal-looking output proxy only: nonempty and no degenerate10gram repetition; terminal finish reason unknown for historical caches
stage_order: Audit common omission candidates and source-image agreement

If genuine evaluable cases exist, freeze candidate geometry and budgets before fresh calls, then compare ordinary text detection+reread and confidence/consensus ranking under identical call and pixel caps
Report all recovered/missed/false/harmful results; do not tune or extend this batch
Only new signal beyond ordinary controls can motivate later document-disjoint confirmation
budget: Stage1 no new OCR, downloads or paid calls; stage2 budget to be frozen separately after verifying data, before recognition
publication: Code, aggregate statistics and opaque decisions only; no source images/raw text or license-uncertain cache redistribution
